symbols.read: Price pushed to 728.68 and the last 1H bar closed green (731.78→732.13), extending the recovery and confirming the neutral-to-bullish bias. The key change is the 4H direction flipping to bullish, so the combined 4H+1H read is now BUY rather than a counter-trend bounce; the SELL tag stays invalidated and the HOLD stance upgrades toward bullish. Fresh bull FVGs at 728.12–728.57, 729.00–730.17 and 730.16–731.14 now sit directly beneath price, with the older stack at 708.95–721.80 intact below the 722.40 lower pivot. Bias is bullish while price holds above 722.40; invalidation is a close below that pivot into the FVG stack, which would revive the bearish case toward 686.36, with 758.44 the upside pivot to watch.

Price has slipped from 82,022.00 to 81,629.75, giving back the 81,837.59–82,010.58 zone reclaimed last read — that reclaim failed, which revises the read back toward the bearish side rather than confirming the stall. The 4H stays bearish, 1H trend is down, and the combined signal remains HOLD, with the SELL setup still invalidated but now closer to its trigger. The stacked bull FVGs at 80,998.01–81,218.23 and 81,246.02–81,700.00 are the only support beneath, and 81,033.66 remains the level that revives the downside case toward 77,715.32; bias is neutral-to-bearish, and structure only turns outright bullish above 84,352.00.
